dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: Hmm... What classes do I have today?

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: I'm having a great time here! There's so much to learn every day, and so much to eat...

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: It hurts when sparks from the forge hit my hands, but I'm not scared of pain!

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: Xilonen said that she's already looking into my past. I haven't heard from her yet... but I believe in her!

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: Now, I write in my diary every day, recording all the interesting things that I experience.

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: The next time I dream of Nechca, I can tell her about it all! She'll be so happy, I know it!

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: I also want to tell her how I'm doing my best to study, eat, and grow up, and that she doesn't need to worry about me!

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: *sigh* But I haven't dreamt of her again. Could she... Did she really leave...?

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: I... want to be a Name Engraver too, just like Xilonen.

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: Though I still can't get my head around all those books, and... I'm also kinda scared of the furnace...

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: I'll do my best! When I grow up, I'll be super powerful...

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: At least... I don't want everyone to have to keep worrying about me.

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: See you! Err... Where'd I leave that textbook again...
